name: point_screen
notes: HARDWARE GESTURE TABLE, whole-arm revision. Offsets from the resting pose. LOOKS LIKE: the arm turns 25 deg toward the screen side, lifts and extends — joint3 up, joint4 pitched down so the forearm points rather than rears back — rolls the wrist to line up with the display, and holds there for 2 seconds while the numbers are read, then returns. This one genuinely points now; the gripper-only version did not. Peak 7.1 deg/s (ceiling 15).

waypoints.label: turn and point at the screen
